description: Save policy: what persists, version handling, RNG streams, event history retention.

persistence.note: Anything computable is recomputed on load from Definition Data. Persisting derived values would desynchronise saves from balance patches.

versioning.note_sequential: v1 to v2 to v3. No direct v1 to v3 shortcut, so there is exactly one path to test.

rng_streams.note: Seed alone does not reproduce a run; consumption counters are saved per stream. Separate streams keep one system's changes from perturbing another's results.

combat_save.note: Combat is deterministic, so it is restored by replaying committed plans rather than storing full combat state. Shares the replay mechanism, and a restore mismatch is itself proof that determinism broke.

event_history.note: Evidence source events must survive compaction; doc 29 allows re-interpreting past evidence with a better analyst, which is impossible if the source is gone.
